$comment: The guard fails on Vercel *infrastructure* signals only. Legitimate prose is
already ignored by design, with no entry needed here:
- "Vercel-style" design tokens and Geist colour references
- the font notes documenting the Next.js-internal turbopack module that
ships inside `next` rather than as a declared dependency
- .gitignore's .vercel/ entry (a local CLI link, never tracked)
Every entry needs `rule`, `match` and `reason`; `file` (optional) narrows it
to a path glob. An entry that stops matching anything is reported as stale so
it gets deleted instead of accumulating.
